rationale: Reproduction question for the newest finding, which is also the thinnest: the claim that an FSM implementing both BatchingFSM and ConfigurationStore never receives StoreConfiguration rests on a single execution with one case per interface. The interaction it describes is deterministic in the source - runFSM picks the batched path once and never calls StoreConfiguration from it - but the callback counts also depend on the cluster reaching the change, on the helper's transports and on the shared recorder, so a second execution of the same fixed experiment is the cheap way to check that the zero and the six are stable rather than an artifact of one run. The retest re-executes experiment 1995fd2023c948c99b650dce1b597cd6-experiment unchanged in a clean copy; the account stands as recorded until its receipt exists, and the question of whether other configuration commands behave the same stays open separately.
